title: Developing questions
before:
Developing questions for a unit can be done in many ways.  The teacher can produce a question that students investigate, or the teacher and students can work together to create questions.  

Click here to access the slide deck

The Interdisciplinary Instruction team has created resources that focus on questioning and supporting students with questioning.
